1: FROM alpine:3.24
2: LABEL maintainer="sig-platform@spinnaker.io"
3: RUN apk --no-cache add --update bash openjdk25-jre
4: # Pick up the latest CA bundle and fail the build if the JVM still trusts emSign ECC Root CA - G3.
5: RUN apk --no-cache upgrade && ! keytool -list -cacerts -storepass changeit | grep -qiE 'emsign.*ecc.*g3'
6: RUN addgroup -S -g 10111 spinnaker
7: RUN adduser -S -G spinnaker -u 10111 spinnaker
8: COPY keel-web/build/install/keel /opt/keel
9: RUN mkdir -p /opt/keel/plugins && chown -R spinnaker:nogroup /opt/keel/plugins
10: USER spinnaker
11: CMD ["/opt/keel/bin/keel"]

1: FROM ubuntu:resolute
2: LABEL maintainer="sig-platform@spinnaker.io"
3: RUN echo "mysql-server mysql-server/root_password password sa" | debconf-set-selections
4: RUN echo "mysql-server mysql-server/root_password_again password sa" | debconf-set-selections
5: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
6:     openjdk-25-jdk \
7:     mysql-server \
8:  && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
9: ENV GRADLE_USER_HOME /workspace/.gradle
10: ENV GRADLE_OPTS -Xmx6g

13:     sed -i "s/bind-address\s*=\s*127.0.0.1/bind-address = 0.0.0.0/" /etc/mysql/mysql.conf.d/mysqld.cnf && \
14:     sed -i "s/port\s*=\s*3306/port = 6603/" /etc/mysql/mysql.conf.d/mysqld.cnf && \
15:     /etc/init.d/mysql start && \
16:     mysql -u root --password=sa -e "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON *.* TO 'root'@'%' IDENTIFIED BY 'sa' WITH GRANT OPTION;" && \
